page_title: CHE 3-0 WOL | Chelsea v Wolves 08/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Chelsea take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Wolves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
83' Enzo Maresca has decided to substitute Joao Pedro and he is replaced by Jamie Gittens (Chelsea).
83' Substitution. Enzo Fernandez makes his way off the pitch and Andrey Santos (Chelsea) comes on as his replacement.

82' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
82' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
82' Chelsea failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Marshall Munetsi (Wolves).
77' Enzo Maresca decides to make a substitution. Pedro Neto will be replaced by Marc Guiu (Chelsea).
77' Substitution. Reece James (Chelsea) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Malo Gusto walks off.

73' 3 - 0 It's a goal! Alejandro Garnacho plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Pedro Neto (Chelsea). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 3:0.
72' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
71' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) for Jean-Ricner Bellegarde.
70' Jamie Collins has decided to make a change. Matheus Mane (Wolves) replaces Hee-Chan Hwang.
69' The Chelsea players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
65' 2 - 0 Joao Pedro (Chelsea) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the middle of the goal.
64' Substitution. Estêvão (Chelsea) in, Liam Delap out.
64' Chelsea can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

61' Nice move, nice attempt! Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
60' The referee has issued a yellow card to Moises Caicedo (Chelsea).
60' Great teamplay by Wolves as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
57' An attempted cross from Hugo Bueno (Wolves) is cleared.
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Chelsea.
53' The ratio of the ball possession is 73:27.
51' 1 - 0 Goal! Alejandro Garnacho swings the ball deep into the box and finds Malo Gusto (Chelsea) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
50' The resulting set piece from Chelsea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
49' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
49' Andre (Wolves) is awarded a yellow card.
48' Wolves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
46' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Pedro Neto (Chelsea), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.

44' Fine attempt! Joao Pedro (Chelsea) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
43' Chelsea control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
41' A quickly taken corner by Chelsea.
41' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
38' Looks like Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
36' The Chelsea players are exchanging some short passes.
35' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) but poses no threat.
34' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
33' Shots on target – 3:0.
31' Robert Sanchez leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Hugo Bueno (Wolves).
29' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
26' The Wolves players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
23' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
22' The resulting corner from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) comes to nothing.
22' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Sam Johnstone.
21' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
20' Total attempts – 6:0.
19' Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
19' Wolves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
18' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
15' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
12' Chelsea enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
11' The ball possession is 66:34.
10' Liam Delap (Chelsea) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
7' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
6' Neat passing move from Chelsea in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Sam Johnstone makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Chelsea comes to nothing.

3' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) fires the ball from the free kick, directing it towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper stretches to punch the ball away. What an excellent save. The linesman makes the right call and Chelsea will have a corner.
3' Alejandro Garnacho (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Wolves will have the kick-off.
